Retrieve the default value for the item at the specified node size.

returns.text: The value for the requested item.

content.text: The defaults are selected so as to be reasonable, but the node size is an imprecise metric that combines multiple aspects of the underlying system; this means that we can't provide optimal defaults in the code for every case.
method can throw std::out_of_range if you ask for values that it does not recognize or request a non-default node-size.

description.text: The item for which the default value is needed
Optional value, used to adjust the result to match the size of a node (0: tiny, ..., 4: huge). If unseated, uses the configured size (NODE_SIZE).
